name: Raycast Pro
tagline: Mac launcher with extensions, snippets, clipboard history, and AI

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $10/month monthly and $8/month annually.

verdictSummary: A personal launcher command or menubar utility is buildable, but Raycast's native polish, extension ecosystem, sync, AI, and Mac integration take serious product work.
coreLoopDIY: Build a command palette with local commands, clipboard history, snippets, and LLM shortcuts.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the launcher is a daily OS layer; latency and polish matter a lot.

priorArt.name: Ulauncher
priorArt.desc: Open-source app launcher prior art; strongest on Linux, not a full Raycast-for-Mac replace

notes: Great example of small utility becoming hard because it sits at OS level.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Raycast Pro (Mac launcher with extensions, snippets, clipboard history, and AI). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build a command palette with local commands, clipboard history, snippets, and LLM shortcuts.
- Needs: macOS app.
- Needs: accessibility permissions.
- Needs: hotkey/clipboard APIs.
- Needs: optional LLM API.
- Needs: local storage.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: extension ecosystem; store/discovery; native speed.
